source_locator: R418: p. 312; R249: table of 1944, 1 November row
current_activity: LXXXIX Corps replaces the LVIII Panzer Corps on the left flank of the XIII SS Corps in Lorraine
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 7 p. 312: "On 1 November the LVIII Panzer Corps headquarters went north to the Seventh Army and was replaced by the LXXXIX Corps (General der Infantrie Gustav Hoehne), which took over the sector on the left flank of Priess' XIII SS Corps"; Lexikon der Wehrmacht, LXXXIX. Armeekorps, table 1944: 1 November, 1. Armee, Heeresgruppe G, "Saarpfalz". Event definition: the corps took over on 1 November. Event support: two source families: CMH and the Lexikon table (both on 1 November). Location: Moyenvic with a precision of 10 km, the town at the western edge of the 361st Volksgrenadier Division sector, which CMH assigns to the corps; the passage names no corps command post. Location approximate: a town point in the corps sector. Location support: CMH gives the 361st VG sector from the Marne-Rhin Canal to just west of Moyenvic; the Lexikon row names the Saarpfalz region. Commander: General der Infantrie Gustav Hoehne. Opponents: US Third Army (XII Corps).

location_qualifier: front east of Bitche through Haguenau to the Rhine
current_activity: LXXXIX Corps becomes an independent command (Group Hoehne) under Army Group G, east of Bitche to the Rhine
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 26 p. 467: "raised the LXXXIX Corps headquarters to the status of an independent command, directly under Balck's Army Group G"; CMH Lorraine ch. 12 p. 535: "Group Hoehne, deployed diagonally east of Bitche on a front extending through Hagenau to the west bank of the Rhine". Event definition: the order of 8 December. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Haguenau with a precision of 25 km, the town on the front the Lorraine volume gives for Group Hoehne. Location approximate: a town point on the front. Location support: CMH names Hagenau on the front. Commander: General der Infantrie Gustav Hoehne. Opponents: US Seventh Army (XV and VI Corps). Context: CMH Lorraine ch. 12 p. 535 calls the command Group Hoehne and does not say it is the LXXXIX Corps; CMH Riviera ch. 26 p. 467 gives the corps headquarters the independent command on the same day, and the two passages are taken to describe one change.
